name: snake-game-demo
description: Simple snake game built with 1Game and @1game/skill

scripts.build:record: npm run record:score5 && npm run replay:score5 && node scripts/copy-record-deploy.mjs
scripts.record:score5: node scripts/plan-snake-score5.mjs > /tmp/snake-plan.json && npx 1gameplay create --entry src/game.tsx --out out/snake-score5.1gamerecord --checkpoint-every 30 && node scripts/apply-snake-plan.mjs out/snake-score5.1gamerecord /tmp/snake-plan.json
